parsedVerdict.reasoning: UpdateOrderService.updateOrder does use-case orchestration, which is the job of the application layer. It loads the aggregate through the injected OrdersRepository (findOrderByIdWithDeliveryman), hands the state changes to domain methods on Order (changeStatus, addInfoToDescription), and saves through the repository. The file has no persistence code of its own: no query building and no ORM or database calls. It has no transport or HTTP logic. It has no business rules either, because those stay in the domain model. The @Injectable decorator is standard dependency-injection wiring for a NestJS application service. Separately, the conditionals use `!== undefined ?? ...`. Because a boolean on the left of `??` is never null or undefined, the right-hand call never runs. That is a correctness bug, but it does not affect which layer the responsibilities belong to.
